summary.answer: Takes owner/health-widget, target health-bar child, controller, pulse class and menu. Captures the bar's width/height once and replaces bar.__playHealthBarLossPulse with an owned closure taking three shader inputs. On invocation, only proceeds when owner alpha is positive, owner has a parent and that parent's alpha is positive. Constructs the supplied pulse class with menu/controller and captured size. Registers clip_over to close its delivered element; sets owner model; links cancelHealthBarAnim and closes the new pulse when its delivered value is truthy. If PulseBar exists sets two shader vectors from the three closure inputs. Then plays DefaultClip, adds the pulse to the bar and sends initialization events. There is no existing-pulse cancellation, size refresh or explicit deregistration on reinitialization in this body. The one stopped caller supplies CoD.KillcamHealthBarPulse as the class; arbitrary other classes are not resolved by name.
